title: [GDScript] Optimize multi-threaded debug calls
body:
Original PR: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118507

Slightly improves debug calls multi-threading performance by itself, but with lock-free `ObjectDB::get_instance` https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118803 the speed actually becomes pretty nice.

## Technical overview
Only calls debug `get_validated_object` if it is needed. This means that when function returns `null` value or in profiling the speed will be the same as in master, but in all other cases this PR improves debug call speed.

The additional speed also comes from removing `StringName` ternary.

## Performace testing
Build commands are the same as in the original PR.
Test project: [testthreads4.6_target.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26926113/testthreads4.6_target.zip)

The basic test was to divide the iterations between threads and to perform the most basic interaction inside the loop, in theory this should imitate doing parallelizable work. The number of iterations was 200_000_000.

The results are presented as tables. In the columns was written the number of threads this attempt used, 0th thread is main thread that serves as the control.
Column type:
- `debug` - tested it in launched from Godot project
- `tool` - tested it inside tool script in editor
- `release` - tested it in export release

Tested on:
- EndeavourOS on X11 
- X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors 
- Vulkan (Forward+) 
- dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (nvidia; 595.58.03) 
- Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9300H CPU @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) 
- 15.49 GiB memory

Includes additional cases with lock-free `ObjectDB::get_instance`, separately and on top of the current changes. 

<details>
<summary>func_base, this one is fine, control</summary>
Setting values directly on the instance fields is also fine

```gdscript
func func_base(count: int) -> int:
    var time_before: int = Time.get_ticks_msec()
    var sum := 0
    for i in count:
        sum += 1
    finished.emit.call_deferred(Time.get_ticks_msec() - time_before)
    return sum
```

<summary>call_base, debug</summary>

```gdscript
func call_base(count: int) -> int:
    var time_before: int = Time.get_ticks_msec()
    var sum := 0
    for i in count:
        sum += get_instance_increment()
    finished.emit.call_deferred(Time.get_ticks_msec() - time_before)
    return sum

func get_instance_increment() -> int:
    return 1
```

<details>
<summary>func_call_null, debug</summary>

```gdscript
func func_call_null(count: int) -> int:
    var time_before: int = Time.get_ticks_msec()
    var temp: Variant = true
    for i in count:
        temp = get_null()
    finished.emit.call_deferred(Time.get_ticks_msec() - time_before)
    return 0 if temp == null else 1

func get_null() -> Variant:
    return null
```
